verdict_reason: The edit correctly sends the stored roles and no type as the API requires, but the helper it calls, storedRolesOf, returns an object its name does not predict.

todos.issue: storedRolesOf(address) (fields.js:53, called at edit.controller.js:158) reads as 'the stored roles' but returns an object { roles }, not a roles array, so the reader must open fields.js to know it is spread into the body; the helper adds nothing over address.roles
todos.fix: Must: the update body's roles come from a name or expression that says what it returns. One way: write roles: address.roles in the spread at edit.controller.js:156-159 and delete storedRolesOf from fields.js if nothing else calls it
